milestones.title: Original GLB asset factory
milestones.completion: Validated source-to-GLB pipeline and real tree, rock, house rendered in a windowed scene.

evidence.source: Blender is NOT installed on this host — the pack's alternative path taken: repository-owned procedural source. tools/assetgen (new workspace bin): limb/blob/box mesh builders with deterministic hash-warps generate the three originals — crooked tapered ash trunk with 3 branch tiers + leaf clusters + root flares; broad granite outcrop with fracture seam + moss patch; croft house (stone plinth, timber walls, dark door inset, steep thatch roof, chimney, 4 named socket nodes) — written as valid glTF 2.0 GLBs (serde_json-assembled doc, named lod nodes, per-color materials with linear baseColorFactor)
evidence.budgets: self-enforced at generation (exit 1 on overflow) AND independently asserted by the loader tests: tree 1666/1800 lod0 (+480/700 lod1, 86/180 lod2), rock 98/600 (+62/180), house 38/2500 — deterministic byte-identical regeneration checked in-tool
evidence.validator: pc3d_assets::v2 (new, 6 tests incl. a 15-case rejection matrix): full schema-v2 rules in typed Rust — id pattern + category match, statuses, provenance kind + >=12-char statement, assets-src|tools source prefixes, assets/compiled/**.glb, mat.* materials, LOD names + >=1 budgets, collision kinds, socket snake_case, duplicates — plus the FACTORY HONESTY LAW: compiled/integrated/proven status requires the .glb on disk (missing-file test proves it)
evidence.loader: pc3d_render::glb (new, 3 tests): GLB header/chunk/accessor parsing with named errors, per-primitive POSITION/NORMAL/u32-index reading, baseColorFactor -> vertex colors, socket.* translations; LOD selection lod0<40m/lod1<120m/lod2 beyond with FALLBACK to the coarsest present (rock has no lod2 — proven); malformed/missing inputs fail named
evidence.render_proof: GPU test + --play-assets/make p3d-assets-window: one windowed scene with 4 placements (near tree lod0, FAR tree lod1 — LOD variety in one frame — rock lod0, house lod0) on real terrain with sky/depth: control-render diff proves tree/rock/house visibly render (deltas 0.22/0.33/0.34) and the crown region carries >=2 green-dominant foliage pixels; record: 4 draws 1725 tris, parsed mesh bytes tree 234480/rock 23760/house 10320, 26 frames p50 9.58 ms / avg 108.9 fps; PNG human-inspected PASS
evidence.inventory: the NWR-001 guardrail rows moved honestly: all three assets integrated + compiled_exists, asset_files_on_disk lists the three .glb paths (recomputed scan), inventory_is_truthful still green — the anti-false-art law was satisfied by SHIPPING the artifacts first
evidence.gates: existing 9-gate battery preserved and re-run green after the change
